hero.subtitle: University of the Ryukyus, Faculty of Engineering | AI, System Development & Handball
paragraphs: I dive into new experiences, learn through conversations, and think deeply about things.
As I explore the possibilities of technology, I also value human connections and kindness.
By stepping into unfamiliar worlds, I am discovering more of my own potential.

about.title: About Me
about.label: ABOUT ME
paragraphs: I study electronics, information, and communication engineering at the University of the Ryukyus.
Alongside my studies, I help run AI courses and develop systems at 305LAB. I am also a member of the university's handball team.
I enjoy meeting and talking with people from different backgrounds. New experiences and human connections are important to me.

items.title: RYUDAIHandTrack
paragraphs: A web app I developed to record and analyze data from handball matches and training sessions.
It visualizes metrics such as shooting accuracy and goalkeeper save rates, and is currently used by the University of the Ryukyus handball team.

items.title: AI Adoption Support for Businesses (OJT)
paragraphs: Through 305LAB, I help businesses use AI to address challenges in their work.

After speaking with the people involved, I use demo data to test potential AI solutions in advance. Based on the results, I work alongside them in hands-on, on-the-job training sessions to show how AI can be used.

items.title: AI Course Operations Support
paragraphs: Through 305LAB, I help run courses on AI.
My responsibilities include course preparation, on-site operations, and supporting participants.

items.title: University Handball
paragraphs: I have played handball for about 12 years, since elementary school, and am now a member of the University of the Ryukyus handball team.

I served as captain of my teams in elementary, junior high, and high school. In junior high school, I captained the Yamaguchi prefectural team for the JOC tournament. In high school, I was vice-captain of the Yamaguchi prefectural team for the National Sports Festival.
